transcript: Fashion week Paris, the world's top designers present their new collections The models walking the runway look like beautiful paintings They wear high-heeled shoes and gorgeous dresses A crown of flowers decorates their heads As if they were queens Backstage staff run about in a hurry We have no time, someone mutters Makeup corrections, hair adjustments Final checks on costumes The smell of staff meals Drifts from the pan After long hours of work, both staff and models are hungry The designer apologizes, I am sorry We have asked you to work without a proper break But once the show begins, everything is beautiful like magic With each step the models take, the venue holds its breath Fashion is not mere clothing It is a means of self-expression and a statement to society In recent years, the fashion industry has been forced to change greatly Environmental issues, workers' rights, diversity Criticism of fast fashion is rising Young designers advocate ethical fashion Use of recycled materials, fair labor conditions Inclusion of diverse body types Clothes should be made in a way that does not sacrifice the earth Major brands too are slowly changing The pressure of if we do not change, we will not survive Moves the whole industry Fashion is a mirror of its era The clothes we choose reveal what we value you
